There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.15 Å. Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent SO₄ tetrahedra and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.10 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 24-34°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.62 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-34°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.49-1.62 Å. S is bonded to four O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent MgO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-36°. There are a spread of S-O bond distances ranging from 1.44-1.54 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites.
